ablution.definition: the act of washing oneself; a ritual cleansing
ablution.chinese: 淨身；沐浴；（宗教）淨禮；洗滌儀式
ablution.reason: 「洗禮」是 baptism，ablution 為宗教性的洗淨禮，誤譯修正

astral.definition: of or relating to the stars; star-shaped; (biology) of the aster in cell division; of a spirit world
astral.chinese: 星的；星狀的；（生物）星狀體的；靈體的
astral.reason: 細胞分裂的 aster 應譯「星狀體」，「星體」易誤解為天體

apiary.definition: a place where bees are kept
apiary.reason: 「蜂房」多指蜂巢，與「養蜂場所」不符

centimeter.definition: a metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter
centimeter.reason: 「釐米」為中國大陸用語，台灣用「公分」

checkered.definition: marked by ups and downs or by disreputable episodes; patterned with alternating squares
checkered.chinese: （經歷）坎坷的；有汙點的；盛衰無常的；有方格圖案的
checkered.reason: 「污」統一為台灣標準字「汙」（與其他詞條一致）

cult.definition: a religious group regarded as extreme; devotion to a person or thing; a fad
cult.chinese: 崇拜；狂熱追捧；邪教；膜拜團體
cult.reason: 「異教團體」誤譯（異教指非主流宗教），改為邪教／膜拜團體並以崇拜義居首

demise.definition: a person's death; the end or failure of something; the transfer of property
demise.chinese: 死亡；終結；倒閉；（法律）（財產）讓渡
demise.reason: 法律義為財產讓渡／轉讓，非「遺贈」

curt.chinese: 簡短無禮的；唐突的；生硬的
curt.reason: 「草率的」意為馬虎，與 curt（說話簡短無禮）不符

conduit.definition: a pipe or channel for fluid or wires; a means of transmitting something; an intermediary
conduit.chinese: 管道；導管；（傳遞資訊等的）途徑；中間人
conduit.reason: 「渠道」為中國大陸用語，改用臺灣用語

conniving.definition: given to scheming in secret toward a dishonest end; secretly permitting wrongdoing
conniving.chinese: 詭計多端的；暗中策劃陰謀的；縱容的
conniving.reason: 「搞陰謀」為大陸口語用法，改為臺灣慣用說法

declaim.definition: to speak or recite rhetorically; to protest loudly
declaim.chinese: 慷慨陳詞；激昂地演說；大聲抨擊；朗誦
declaim.reason: 定義有 protest loudly，補上「抨擊」義

conventional.definition: following accepted customs; lacking originality; (of weapons) non-nuclear
conventional.chinese: 傳統的；慣例的；保守的；常規的；（武器）非核的
conventional.reason: 定義有 non-nuclear，中文缺此義

empiricism.definition: the theory that all knowledge derives from sense experience; reliance on experience rather than theory
empiricism.chinese: 經驗主義；經驗論；重視實證（而非理論）
empiricism.reason: 「庸醫術」為罕見古義且與定義不符，改為定義中的依賴經驗義

doctor.definition: to falsify or tamper with; to adulterate; to treat medically; a physician; a holder of a doctorate
doctor.chinese: v. 竄改；偽造；摻雜；治療；n. 醫生；博士

dichotomy.definition: a division into two contrasting or opposed parts
dichotomy.chinese: 二分法；一分為二；截然對立

complacency.definition: smug self-satisfaction, often unaware of dangers or deficiencies
complacency.chinese: 自滿；自鳴得意；安於現狀

donor.definition: a person who gives money or goods; a person who gives blood or an organ
donor.chinese: 捐贈者；捐款人；捐血者；（器官）捐贈人

escalator.definition: a moving staircase; a contract clause allowing adjustments in wages or prices
escalator.reason: 「手扶梯」與「電扶梯」重複，臺灣通用電扶梯

exhume.definition: to dig up (a buried body); to bring back from neglect or obscurity
exhume.chinese: 掘出（屍體）；發掘；使重見天日
exhume.reason: 括號位置不當，改為動詞＋受詞的自然寫法

fastidious.definition: very attentive to accuracy and detail; hard to please; excessively particular; very concerned about cleanliness
fastidious.chinese: 一絲不苟的；挑剔的；過分講究的；有潔癖的
fastidious.reason: 「潔癖的」不通順，改為「有潔癖的」

feisty.definition: spirited and determined; lively; aggressive; touchy
feisty.chinese: 精力充沛的；有幹勁的；好鬥的；易怒的
feisty.reason: GRE 多取「活潑堅定」義，調整順序

foster.definition: to promote the growth of; to encourage; to bring up a child not one's own; giving parental care without legal adoption
foster.chinese: v. 促進；培養；鼓勵；撫養（他人子女）；adj. 寄養的
foster.reason: 「收養」為 adopt 的誤譯，foster 指非法定收養的撫養

gaff.definition: a hooked pole for landing fish; a spar on a ship; a blunder; (slang) one's home
gaff.chinese: （捕魚用）手鉤；（船）斜桁；大錯；（俚）住處

glut.definition: an excessive supply; to oversupply; to fill to excess; to overeat
glut.chinese: n. 過剩；供過於求；v. 使過量；充斥；暴食
glut.reason: 「吃飽」與 overeat 不符，改為「暴食」

grudge.definition: a persistent feeling of resentment; to give reluctantly; to resent
grudge.chinese: n. 怨恨；積怨；v. 不情願給；怨恨
grudge.reason: v. 義為 resent（怨恨），「嫉妒」不準確

husk.definition: the dry outer covering of a seed or fruit; a worthless shell; to remove the husk from
husk.chinese: n. 外殼；穀殼；空殼；v. 剝去外殼

entity.definition: a thing with distinct and independent existence; an organization or body
entity.reason: 「獨立存在」與「實體」重複；補上英文定義中的組織、機構義

expediency.definition: the quality of being convenient and practical though perhaps improper; self-interest; advantageousness
expediency.chinese: 權宜；私利考量；方便；得當
expediency.reason: 「權宜之計」是 expedient 的名詞義（手段），expediency 指權宜性質

hostility.definition: unfriendliness or opposition; acts of warfare
hostility.reason: 「戰鬥行為」不自然；hostilities 指戰事

genome.definition: the complete set of genes or genetic material of an organism
genome.reason: 臺灣慣用「基因體」，調整順序

grandstand.definition: to behave ostentatiously to impress onlookers; the main seating area at a stadium
grandstand.chinese: v. 譁眾取寵；作秀；n. （體育場）主看臺
grandstand.reason: 「正面看臺」不是臺灣常用說法

invoke.definition: to cite (a law or authority) in support; to appeal to; to call on (a deity) in prayer; to evoke; (computing) to call (a program)
invoke.chinese: 援引（法律或權威）；訴諸；祈求；喚起；（程式）呼叫
invoke.reason: 「調用」為大陸用語，改台灣用法「呼叫」

offal.definition: the edible internal organs of an animal; refuse or waste
offal.reason: 「下水」為大陸用語，台灣不用，刪除

mandarin.definition: an influential official, esp. a bureaucrat; a high official of imperial China; standard Chinese; a mandarin orange; (of style) ornate and elaborate
mandarin.chinese: n. 有權勢的官員；官僚；（中國古代）官吏；國語；橘子；adj. （文體）雕琢的
mandarin.reason: 「權威官員」措辭不當；imperial China 不限清朝

intersection.definition: the meeting or overlap of two things; a point where lines cross; a place where roads meet; (mathematics) the set of shared elements
intersection.chinese: 交會；交叉點；十字路口；（數學）交集
intersection.reason: GRE 閱讀多用「交會」義，調整順序

labile.definition: liable to change; unstable; (of emotions) easily altered; (chemistry) readily breaking down
labile.chinese: 不穩定的；易變的；（情緒）起伏不定的；（化學）易分解的
labile.reason: 補上英文釋義中的化學義

obligate.definition: to bind legally or morally; to compel; to make grateful; (biology) restricted to a particular way of life
obligate.chinese: v. 使負義務；強制；使感激；adj. （生物）專性的
obligate.reason: 「必然的」與英文釋義不符，刪除

mishap.definition: an unlucky accident; a minor misfortune
mishap.reason: 英文釋義自我循環（a minor mishap），修正

obsolescent.definition: becoming obsolete; going out of use; (biology) gradually becoming vestigial
obsolescent.chinese: 逐漸過時的；即將淘汰的；（生物）退化中的
obsolescent.reason: 英文釋義補上中文已有的生物義

onset.definition: the beginning of something, especially something unpleasant; (archaic) an attack
onset.chinese: 開始；發作；（疾病）初期；（古）攻擊
onset.reason: 「攻擊」為古義，比照英文釋義加註

proscribe.definition: to forbid, especially by law; to denounce or condemn; to banish or outlaw
proscribe.chinese: 禁止；（公開）譴責；放逐；剝奪法律保護
proscribe.reason: 「排斥」不符 denounce or condemn，改為「譴責」

putative.definition: generally considered or reputed to be; supposed or assumed
putative.chinese: 一般認為的；推定的；假定的；所謂的
putative.reason: 「公認的」誤導（putative 指「被認為、未經證實」），改為「一般認為的」

racy.definition: slightly indecent or risqué; lively and spirited; having a strong distinctive flavor
racy.chinese: 略帶色情的；不太正經的；生動活潑的；（味道）濃郁獨特的
racy.reason: 「猥褻的」語氣過重且與「有點色情的」重複，改為較貼切的「略帶色情的」

rambunctious.chinese: 喧鬧的；精力旺盛而難管束的；吵吵嚷嚷的
rambunctious.reason: 「狂暴的」語意過重，與 boisterous 不符

repository.definition: a place where things are stored; a rich source of information; a person entrusted with secrets
repository.chinese: 儲藏處；寶庫；知識庫；（軟體）儲存庫；（祕密的）託付對象
repository.reason: 「知己」誤導，定義為「被託付秘密的人」

seamy.definition: sordid and disreputable; showing the unpleasant side of life
seamy.reason: 用字統一為臺灣教育部標準字「汙」

robust.definition: strong and healthy; sturdy and able to withstand problems; (of flavor) full and rich
robust.chinese: 強健的；穩健的；健全的；（味道）濃郁的
robust.reason: 定義為 flavor，「（酒味）」過窄，改為「（味道）」

quidnunc.definition: a person eager to know the latest news or gossip; a busybody
quidnunc.chinese: 愛打聽消息的人；愛說長道短的人；好管閒事的人
quidnunc.reason: 排序：定義主義為「愛打聽新聞八卦者」，應列第一

saturnine.definition: gloomy, morose, or sullen in temperament
saturnine.chinese: 陰沉的；憂鬱的；鬱鬱寡歡的
saturnine.reason: 「冷漠的」不符 sullen／morose，改為「鬱鬱寡歡的」

prospectus.definition: a printed document describing a school, business, or investment offer; a plan for a forthcoming project
prospectus.chinese: 簡介；說明書；招生簡章；公開說明書；計畫書
prospectus.reason: 「招股說明書」為中國用語，臺灣稱「公開說明書」

recognize.definition: to identify from previous encounters; to acknowledge the existence, validity, or legality of; to show official appreciation of
recognize.chinese: 認出；承認；（正式）認可；賞識；表彰

replicate.definition: to make an exact copy of; to repeat a study or experiment to obtain consistent results; (of genetic material) to reproduce itself
replicate.chinese: 複製；重複（實驗並得到相同結果）；（遺傳物質）自我複製
replicate.reason: 定義為 genetic material，「（細胞）」不準確

stigmatize.definition: to brand as disgraceful; to describe or regard with strong disapproval
stigmatize.chinese: 使蒙上汙名；視為可恥；指責；譴責
stigmatize.reason: 「污衊」指捏造事實誹謗，與原義不符，改為指責／譴責並統一用字

swear.definition: to take an oath; to promise solemnly; to assert emphatically; to use profane language
swear.chinese: 發誓；宣誓；斷言；咒罵；說髒話
swear.reason: 調整順序，常考的發誓／斷言義置前

toy.definition: to consider idly or casually; to handle or play with absent-mindedly; an object for a child to play with
toy.chinese: v. 隨便想想；姑且考慮；擺弄；玩弄；n. 玩具
toy.reason: 「不認真考慮」易誤解為不考慮，改為 toy with an idea 的「姑且考慮」

stodgy.definition: dull and old-fashioned; (of food) heavy and filling
stodgy.chinese: 乏味的；古板的；（食物）厚重難消化的
stodgy.reason: stodgy 食物是厚重飽脹，非「油膩」

stupefy.definition: to astonish; to make unable to think or feel properly
stupefy.chinese: 使驚呆；使茫然；使麻木；使昏沉
stupefy.reason: 「使昏迷」過重，改為使茫然／使昏沉以符定義

subterfuge.definition: deceit used to achieve one's goal or conceal something
subterfuge.reason: 「托詞」為大陸合併字，臺灣用「託詞」

shaver.definition: an electric razor; a person who shaves; a young boy
shaver.chinese: 電動刮鬍刀；剃刀；（口）小夥子

ultrasonic.definition: having frequencies above the range of human hearing
ultrasonic.chinese: 超音波的；超出人耳聽覺範圍的
ultrasonic.reason: 「超聲」為大陸用語，臺灣用「超音波」

sibilant.definition: making a hissing sound; a speech sound such as s or sh
sibilant.chinese: adj. 嘶嘶作響的；發嘶音的；n. （語音）齒擦音
sibilant.reason: 「嘶擦音」非通用術語，臺灣語音學稱「齒擦音」

underline.definition: to emphasize; to draw a line under; a line drawn under text
underline.chinese: v. 強調；突顯；在…下畫線；n. 底線

underscore.definition: to emphasize; to underline; a line drawn under text
underscore.chinese: v. 強調；突顯；在…下畫線；n. 底線

sallow.chinese: adj. （臉色）蠟黃的；氣色差的；n. （植）黃花柳
sallow.definition: (of complexion) of an unhealthy yellowish color; a willow tree
sallow.reason: （植）黃華柳為誤字，應為黃花柳（goat willow）
